fit_reason: Whole 2008 Acura MDX SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on the front, most visible on the driver side
Silver paint looks flat and dull on the hood and front fenders
Light dirt and road film along the lower doors and rocker area
Black lower front bumper trim looks faded and grayish
Wheels look dull with brake dust on the faces
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2008 Acura MDX. The headlights look hazy and yellowed in the photos, and the silver paint on the hood looks a bit flat. We do mobile pre-sale details that include headlight restoration and a buff, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
